newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EVN sees 96/7 pre-tax below previous yr.
newsitem.headline: EVN sees 96/7 pre-tax below previous yr.

text.p: Austrian regional utility Energieversorgung Niederoesterreich (EVN) said on Tuesday it expected its 1996/7 pre-tax profit to be below the 1.484 billion schillings it posted in 1995/6.
"We have budgeted for a slightly lower pre-tax profit in the coming year," chief executive Rudolf Gruber told a news conference.
He added that EVN aimed to maintain its basic 23 schillings dividend payment in 1996/7. For 1995/6 it has announced 23 schillings plus a two schillings bonus. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
